result_summary.title: Chargeback Handler: Compliance reports incomplete and audit logs missing entries
result_summary.description: We are facing a significant issue with the Chargeback Handler in our US-East staging environment. Our compliance reports are coming through incomplete, and we have detected gaps in the audit log where expected entries are missing. This is a high-impact issue for our 101 affected users as it compromises our ability to demonstrate compliance during internal audits. We suspect the logging or reporting mechanism within the Chargeback Handler is malfunctioning.
